about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • The basic configuration of the Ellydium cover frigate “Drag’Thir”

  • Ellydium cover frigate weapon “Drag’Du”

  • Active module “Prism”

Additionally, the pilot receives:

  • “Zale Ellestone” portrait

  • “Ellydium corporation” sticker

  • “Crystal DNA” sticker

  • “Ellydium skull” sticker

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

The newest cover frigate created by the Ellydium corporation based on crystallid technology and living crystallid nodes. The UMC has praised the ship’s capabilities and plans mass purchases of Drag’Thir for their mercenaries. The ship started production in 4625, as the Ellydium managed to secure the samples needed to complete the project only in 4624.
